scope_statement: This registry maps bounded proximal-distal mechanisms to the measurements required to observe, estimate, or reject them. It does not convert model outputs, literature context, or synthetic traces into human validation.
measurement_boundary: Direct observation is reserved for a calibrated sensor observable in its declared frame and units. Derived quantities retain their inverse-problem, filtering, model, synchronization, and allocation dependencies. Missing governed participant data remain unavailable.

modalities.frame_authority: A laboratory frame and every segment frame must be declared, with handedness, rotation representation, marker-to-segment calibration, and club-face convention preserved in the dataset manifest.
modalities.unit_authority: SI length, time, angle, linear velocity, and angular velocity units are required at ingestion; normalized swing time is an additional coordinate rather than a replacement for seconds.
modalities.calibration_requirement: Static or functional segment calibration, camera calibration residuals, marker reconstruction residuals, club rigid-body residuals, and filtering choices must be retained per session.
modalities.synchronization_requirement: Hardware or independently verified common-clock synchronization to every wrench, EMG, shaft, ultrasound, and launch stream is required; event alignment alone is insufficient.
modalities.event_definition: Address, takeaway, backswing top, downswing start, release-related states, impact, and follow-through events require algorithm, coordinate, search interval, ambiguity flag, and uncertainty in seconds.
modalities.processing_method: Retain raw trajectories; preregister gap filling, rigid-body reconstruction, coordinate construction, filtering, differentiation, event detection, and all sensitivity variants.
modalities.missingness_rule: No interpolated interval may cross an unqualified duration or impact discontinuity; trial- and channel-level missingness, reconstruction failure, and exclusion reasons remain explicit.
modalities.uncertainty_propagation: Repeat primary estimands across registered marker, joint-center, coordinate-method, cutoff-frequency, event-time, and differentiation perturbations with participant-level resampling.
directly_observed: rigid-cluster pose estimates under the declared reconstruction
modalities.data_gate: A governed participant-separated motion dataset must retain raw trajectories, calibration, event definitions, missing-data flags, and synchronized sensor timestamps.

observables: center of pressure when vertical-force validity conditions hold
modalities.frame_authority: Each six-axis ground wrench must be transported to a declared point in a declared laboratory frame before aggregation; plate assignment and foot contacts must be retained.
modalities.unit_authority: Forces are newtons, moments are newton-metres, center of pressure is metres, impulse is newton-seconds, and power requires a compatible same-point twist.
modalities.calibration_requirement: Zero, bias, cross-talk, coordinate transform, support-surface height, saturation, and center-of-pressure validity thresholds must be verified before participant analysis.
modalities.synchronization_requirement: Force-plate samples must share or be mapped to the motion-capture clock with measured offset and drift uncertainty.
modalities.event_definition: Force windows use the independently registered motion events plus foot-contact and valid-vertical-force states; center-of-pressure is unavailable below the registered force threshold.
modalities.processing_method: Retain raw channels; preregister zero correction, calibration matrix, filtering, wrench transport, center-of-pressure calculation, impulse integration, and whole-system closure.
modalities.missingness_rule: Foot bridging, saturation, invalid center-of-pressure, incomplete plate contact, and absent synchronized kinematics are typed exclusions rather than imputed valid wrench data.
modalities.uncertainty_propagation: Propagate bias, calibration, reference-point, force-threshold, event-window, filter, and integration perturbations through impulse, moment, power, and Newton-Euler residuals.
directly_observed: plate-level impulse under the declared integration window
not_identifiable: club energy transfer from force magnitude alone
modalities.data_gate: A governed participant-held-out dataset must provide synchronized raw plate channels, plate geometry, transforms, calibration records, and whole-system Newton-Euler closure variables.

modalities.frame_authority: Each hand wrench requires its own sensor frame, measured contact-center transform, club frame, grip-midpoint transport rule, and force-action convention.
modalities.unit_authority: Forces are newtons, free moments and transported couples are newton-metres, work is joules, and power is watts at compatible contact twists.
modalities.calibration_requirement: Six-axis calibration, cross-talk matrix, thermal drift, zero history, overload checks, sensor compliance, contact-center tracking, and club inertial calibration are required.
modalities.synchronization_requirement: Both wrench sensors require a shared hardware clock synchronized to club and body kinematics, shaft sensing, EMG, and impact measurement.
modalities.event_definition: Grip-wrench phases use the common registered motion and impact events; contact-center changes, grip acquisition, sensor zero, and any overload interval are separate typed events.
modalities.processing_method: Retain raw bridges and calibration matrices; preregister zero correction, cross-talk correction, frame transport, contact-center model, common/differential decomposition, power, impulse, and work.
modalities.missingness_rule: Saturation, cable artifact, lost contact-center tracking, invalid zero, or either missing hand channel blocks bilateral allocation; net club motion cannot fill the missing hand wrench.
modalities.uncertainty_propagation: Propagate calibration covariance, cross-talk, zero drift, contact-center, frame, synchronization, and sensor-compliance perturbations through allocation, couple, power, and inverse dynamics.
directly_observed: measured bilateral common and differential modes after declared transforms
not_identifiable: muscle or scapular source of a measured wrench
distributed pressure from a lumped wrench
modalities.data_gate: No qualifying governed golf dataset with synchronized participant-level bilateral six-axis grip wrenches has been located. Acquisition, calibration, governance, and participant-held-out qualification are required before human allocation claims.

observables: activation onset and offset under a preregistered detector
modalities.frame_authority: Electrode identity, side, anatomical placement, orientation, reference, and synchronized time base must be explicit; EMG has no mechanical wrench frame.
modalities.unit_authority: Raw voltage and processing units must be retained; normalized amplitude is dimensionless and must name its normalization task and uncertainty.
modalities.calibration_requirement: Skin preparation, placement verification, amplifier settings, cross-talk assessment, normalization protocol, and preregistered filtering and onset detection are required.
modalities.synchronization_requirement: Hardware synchronization to motion, bilateral wrench, ultrasound, shaft, and impact streams is required with electromechanical-delay sensitivity retained.
modalities.event_definition: Activation onset and offset are detector-specific events with threshold, baseline window, persistence rule, phase window, and timing uncertainty; mechanical events remain independently defined.
modalities.processing_method: Retain raw voltage; preregister artifact rejection, band-pass and notch filtering, rectification, envelope construction, normalization, onset detection, and electromechanical-delay sensitivity.
modalities.missingness_rule: Detached, saturated, motion-artifact-dominated, or cross-talk-failed channels are unavailable; adjacent muscles, limbs, or model activations cannot replace them.
modalities.uncertainty_propagation: Repeat onset, amplitude, coactivation, and mechanics associations across placement, normalization, filter, detector, electromechanical-delay, and fatigue-state perturbations.
modalities.data_gate: A source-qualified, governed golf dataset with synchronized raw EMG, placement records, normalization trials, bilateral mechanics, and participant holdout is required.

modalities.frame_authority: Probe pose and image coordinates must be registered to anatomy and the motion-capture frame; out-of-plane motion and probe pressure must be reported.
modalities.unit_authority: Lengths and displacements are metres, angles are radians or explicitly labelled degrees, and time is seconds on the common clock.
modalities.calibration_requirement: Image scale, probe tracking, anatomical registration, segmentation reliability, probe pressure, and inter-rater or automated-tracking error must be qualified.
modalities.synchronization_requirement: Frame timestamps must be synchronized to EMG, motion, bilateral wrench, and impact streams with dropped-frame detection.
modalities.event_definition: Tissue landmarks use the common mechanical events plus probe-validity intervals; out-of-plane loss, dropped frames, and tracking reacquisition are typed events.
modalities.processing_method: Retain source images and probe poses; preregister segmentation, fascicle or junction tracking, anatomical registration, smoothing, and any constitutive conversion.
modalities.missingness_rule: Out-of-plane loss, probe slip, excessive pressure, failed segmentation, or inadequate frame rate makes the tissue estimand unavailable rather than model-filled.
uncertainty_sources: limited field of view and sampling rate
modalities.uncertainty_propagation: Propagate image scale, probe pose, registration, segmentation, out-of-plane, event-time, and constitutive-parameter uncertainty separately from biological between-trial variability.
not_identifiable: whole-muscle stiffness from one imaging plane
modalities.data_gate: A source-qualified dynamic golf acquisition must demonstrate tracked probe registration, sufficient sampling, synchronized mechanics, repeatability, and participant-held-out processing.

observables: calibrated modal deformation and load proxies
modalities.frame_authority: Gauge axes, inertial axes, shaft material coordinates, grip and head reference points, and transforms to the club frame must be declared.
modalities.unit_authority: Strain is dimensionless, acceleration is metres per second squared, angular rate is radians per second, reconstructed loads use SI units, and modal coordinates retain their normalization.
modalities.calibration_requirement: Static and dynamic load calibration, temperature compensation, bridge balance, inertial calibration, sensor mass effects, modal calibration, and bandwidth must be qualified.
modalities.synchronization_requirement: Shaft and inertial samples require a shared or measured common clock with grip wrenches, motion, and impact sensing.
modalities.event_definition: Structural events include excitation onset, peak load, deformation extrema, zero crossings, impact, saturation, and sensor-ringdown intervals on the common clock.
modalities.processing_method: Retain raw strain and inertial channels; preregister temperature and zero correction, calibration transform, rigid-motion subtraction, modal or load inversion, filtering, and work-energy reconstruction.
modalities.missingness_rule: Saturation, bridge imbalance, temperature failure, inadequate bandwidth, unqualified impact ringdown, or lost clock mapping blocks the affected load and energy estimand.
uncertainty_sources: sensor mass, bandwidth, and impact saturation
modalities.uncertainty_propagation: Propagate calibration covariance, temperature, gauge pose, rigid-motion subtraction, modal truncation, damping, boundary-condition, timing, and bandwidth perturbations.
not_identifiable: distributed shaft state beyond the qualified sensor model
hand allocation from net shaft load
modalities.data_gate: A source-qualified instrumented-club dataset and calibration artifact must establish bandwidth, load reconstruction, structural-model validity, synchronization, and participant holdout.

observables: ball launch velocity, direction, and spin
modalities.frame_authority: Device coordinates, target line, laboratory and club-frame transforms, measurement volume, handedness, and impact event convention must be declared.
modalities.unit_authority: SI velocity, angle, angular-rate, distance, and time units are canonical; vendor display units and derived proprietary metrics must be mapped and identified.
modalities.calibration_requirement: Device model and firmware, setup geometry, environmental inputs, alignment, reference-device comparison, missing-shot rules, and uncertainty by metric are required.
modalities.synchronization_requirement: Impact timestamps and shot identifiers must reconcile one-to-one with motion, wrench, EMG, ultrasound, and instrumented-club records.
modalities.event_definition: Impact and reported delivery events follow the qualified device definition and are reconciled to an independent impact detector with offset, ambiguity, and shot-match status.
modalities.processing_method: Retain primary device outputs and flags; preregister unit conversion, coordinate alignment, environmental correction, shot matching, outlier rules, and exclusion of unverifiable proprietary composites.
modalities.missingness_rule: Unmatched, unreported, low-confidence, out-of-volume, misaligned, or firmware-incompatible shots remain missing and cannot be reconstructed from the simulation outcome.
uncertainty_sources: proprietary derived metrics and environmental correction
modalities.uncertainty_propagation: Propagate device repeatability, alignment, reference-comparison, environmental, event-time, shot-match, impact-location, and firmware strata through held-out outcomes.
directly_observed: shot-level measurement availability and quality flags
modalities.data_gate: A source-qualified validation and governed shot-level dataset must retain device, firmware, setup, raw qualified metrics, uncertainty, synchronization, and participant holdout.

mechanisms.statement: Declared segment angular-velocity histories and peak order are observable only under a specified coordinate and signal-processing method; peak order alone is not energy flow.
mechanisms.model_quantity: Segment poses, angular velocities, peak times, coordinate-method sensitivity, and compatible segment energy or interface-power histories.
mechanisms.observable_discriminator: A preregistered participant-held-out comparison must show whether peak-order predictions remain stable across coordinate and filtering variants while same-frame joint power, interface power, and segment-energy histories distinguish transfer from coincident sequencing.
competing_explanations: coordinate and angular-velocity decomposition choice
filtering and event normalization
different task objectives producing similar peak order
mechanisms.falsifier: The proposed ordering or its claimed association fails under preregistered coordinate methods, participant holdout, or compatible energy and power accounting.
mechanisms.adverse_case: A swing exhibits the same peak order with opposite interface-power direction or a different order with equal or better delivery outcome.

mechanisms.statement: The external ground wrench can be measured, but its contribution to whole-system momentum and its association with club delivery do not by themselves identify internal transfer or control allocation.
mechanisms.model_quantity: Transported bilateral ground wrench, impulse, compatible contact power, whole-system Newton-Euler closure, and held-out delivery association.
mechanisms.observable_discriminator: Synchronized force plates and whole-body kinematics must distinguish a ground-wrench change that precedes and closes a predicted momentum change from one that merely covaries with size, speed, or a later motion response.
competing_explanations: ground wrench as a response to rather than cause of motion
common dependence on golfer size and speed
zero-work redirection at stationary ideal contact
mechanisms.falsifier: Transported wrenches fail calibration or Newton-Euler closure, or preregistered held-out associations do not exceed the stated null and uncertainty bounds.
mechanisms.adverse_case: Higher club delivery occurs with lower impulse or with a different wrench timing after participant and equipment effects are controlled.

mechanisms.statement: A net club wrench does not uniquely identify the lead-hand and trail-hand wrench allocation because the bilateral map contains unobservable internal modes.
mechanisms.model_quantity: Lead and trail six-axis wrenches, grip-midpoint resultant and couple, allocation null space, cross-talk correction, and contact-center sensitivity.
mechanisms.observable_discriminator: Independently calibrated bilateral six-axis wrenches must resolve common and differential modes that produce the same net club wrench and test whether the registered null-space and contact-center predictions survive calibration uncertainty.
competing_explanations: different common and differential hand modes producing the same net wrench
distributed grip contact represented by lumped sensors
wrist, arm, and scapular actions sharing a task-equivalent wrench
mechanisms.falsifier: An independently calibrated bilateral dataset contradicts the predicted wrench-map rank, null mode, or registered allocation uncertainty.
mechanisms.adverse_case: Task-equivalent measured allocations reverse the modeled load or robustness ranking without changing net club delivery.

mechanisms.statement: Activation timing can contextualize neural drive but cannot identify individual muscle force, net joint torque, or hand-wrench allocation without additional dynamics and measurements.
mechanisms.model_quantity: Preregistered activation onset, amplitude, coactivation proxies, electromechanical delay sensitivity, and association with bilateral mechanics.
mechanisms.observable_discriminator: Raw synchronized EMG must improve held-out prediction of measured bilateral wrench or impedance-related response beyond kinematics and timing alone, across electrode, normalization, detector, and electromechanical-delay sensitivities.
competing_explanations: cross-talk or normalization artifacts
activation producing stiffness rather than net task torque
unmeasured deep-muscle and passive-tissue contributions
mechanisms.falsifier: The claimed activation sequence is not repeatable across placements and detectors or does not predict held-out mechanical observables beyond uncertainty.
mechanisms.adverse_case: Similar bilateral wrenches arise from materially different EMG patterns, or the same EMG pattern accompanies opposite wrench allocation.

mechanisms.statement: Muscle-tendon force, stiffness, and elastic work are not directly identified by joint motion or surface EMG and require a declared constitutive and musculoskeletal inverse problem.
mechanisms.model_quantity: Fascicle and tendon kinematics, muscle-tendon force bounds, activation dynamics, passive properties, stiffness sensitivity, and residual joint-moment closure.
mechanisms.observable_discriminator: Synchronized tissue imaging, EMG, motion, and external wrenches must rule out admissible activation and passive-tissue countermodels by closing held-out joint moments and measured fascicle or tendon trajectories within registered uncertainty.
competing_explanations: muscle redundancy
passive tissue and co-contraction
subject-specific moment arms and tendon compliance
mechanisms.falsifier: No admissible calibrated parameter set closes measured motion and external wrenches, or the claimed force pattern is not robust across feasible activation solutions.
mechanisms.adverse_case: Different feasible muscle-force solutions reproduce the same joint and hand mechanics while reversing the proposed energetic attribution.

mechanisms.statement: Shaft deformation can store and return elastic energy, but delivery benefit depends on calibrated structure, excitation, damping, boundary conditions, and phase rather than a universal recoil advantage.
mechanisms.model_quantity: Modal deformation, strain-derived load, elastic energy, damping loss, grip and head power, rigid-shaft counterfactual, and model-order sensitivity.
mechanisms.observable_discriminator: Calibrated strain and inertial histories must be predicted better by the flexible model than by a rigid-shaft countermodel and must show phase-consistent stored and returned energy without violating measured grip, head, or damping power closure.
competing_explanations: rigid-body motion leaking into inferred deformation
unmodeled grip and head compliance
phase-dependent load redistribution without net delivery gain
mechanisms.falsifier: A calibrated flexible model fails held-out strain and inertial traces or does not outperform a rigid countermodel under preregistered uncertainty and refinement gates.
mechanisms.adverse_case: Matched-load flexible and rigid cases show opposite speed effects across plausible stiffness, damping, or timing conditions.

mechanisms.statement: Club and ball delivery outcomes are endpoints, not measurements of the internal mechanism that produced them, and require device-specific qualification before cross-study comparison.
mechanisms.model_quantity: Impact club velocity and orientation, ball launch and spin, shot-matching quality, uncertainty, and participant-held-out outcome distributions.
mechanisms.observable_discriminator: A device-qualified held-out comparison must determine whether the proposed internal mechanism improves prediction of delivery and launch beyond impact location, equipment, participant, and device countermodels.
competing_explanations: impact location and equipment properties
device and firmware differences
multiple control histories producing equivalent delivery
mechanisms.falsifier: The proposed model fails preregistered held-out delivery distributions or its effect is smaller than device, impact, and participant uncertainty.
mechanisms.adverse_case: A mechanically different strategy produces an equivalent or better qualified delivery outcome with lower load or variability.

mechanisms.statement: A late negative net club couple or generalized torque does not identify passive tissue action, active wrist braking, or separated-hand force origin without bilateral wrenches and compatible anatomical dynamics.
mechanisms.model_quantity: Net club couple, direct wrist moment, force-generated grip couple, zero-command counterfactual, compatible power, activation context, and allocation uncertainty.
mechanisms.observable_discriminator: Synchronized bilateral wrenches, club and body kinematics, shaft loads, and activation context must separate a force-generated couple, an active wrist-braking moment, a compliant recoil contribution, and a motion-dependent interaction term at the same late-downswing events.
competing_explanations: active negative wrist torque
separated-hand force couple
shaft and grip compliance
motion-dependent interaction and constraint reactions
mechanisms.falsifier: Measured bilateral wrenches, shaft loads, and inverse-dynamics closure reject the registered sign, timing, persistence, or allocation predictions across participant-held-out trials.
mechanisms.adverse_case: Negative net couple occurs without the predicted differential hand mode, or the predicted differential mode occurs without favorable club-energy transfer.

mechanisms.statement: Slack and preload must be defined through a measurable transmission law; kinematic lag, low activation, and zero transmitted torque are not interchangeable observations.
mechanisms.model_quantity: Contact active set, dead-zone occupancy, grip preload, transmission stiffness and damping, torque-error impulse, reattachment timing, and adverse perturbation response.
mechanisms.observable_discriminator: A calibrated transmission experiment must distinguish a true dead-zone or contact-state transition from compliant yielding and impedance change using preload, force-displacement hysteresis, reattachment timing, and held-out perturbation response.
competing_explanations: intentional compliant yielding rather than slack
sensor threshold and contact-model artifacts
co-contraction changing impedance without changing net wrench
mechanisms.falsifier: A calibrated transmission model cannot distinguish the declared states above sensor uncertainty or the predicted preload advantage disappears under held-out perturbations and fatigue.
mechanisms.adverse_case: A controlled low-preload state improves delivery robustness or load without increasing timing sensitivity, or persistent preload increases adverse load.

transportability.limitation: Subject-scaled models and synthetic anthropometric designs test geometry sensitivity but do not estimate a human population distribution or validate segment inertial parameters for this task.
transportability.data_gate: Retain participant stature, mass, segment calibration, grip span, club fit, and anthropometric-model uncertainty; freeze training-only strata and evaluate held-out calibration and mechanism effects.

transportability.limitation: Female and male anthropometric design profiles are engineering inputs, while much of the cited golf evidence uses male samples; no sex-stratified mechanism or allocation result is established.
transportability.data_gate: Recruit and retain sex and relevant anthropometric strata without treating sex as a mechanical surrogate; preregister interaction estimates and suppress unsupported subgroup inference.

transportability.limitation: An age-diverse observational speed-handicap sample does not identify how age modifies bilateral allocation, tissue dynamics, fatigue, or the proposed transfer mechanisms.
transportability.data_gate: Retain age continuously, define age-range transport targets prospectively, measure relevant capacity and recovery covariates, and evaluate participant-held-out calibration and interactions.

transportability.limitation: Skilled and comparison samples support bounded descriptive differences, but gross sequencing and selected associations do not identify a transferable causal strategy.
transportability.data_gate: Define skill independently of the tested outcome, preserve continuous handicap and experience, stratify participant holdout, and test whether mechanisms add prediction beyond baseline delivery and capacity.

transportability.limitation: The model outputs mechanical proxies and explicitly withholds injury and tissue-loading conclusions; no governed injury history or prospective adverse outcome is linked to the transfer results.
transportability.data_gate: Collect governed injury history, symptoms, exposure, clinical constraints, tissue-load uncertainty, and adverse events under an approved protocol; performance cannot stand in for safety.

transportability.limitation: Most cited golf samples and the registered sign conventions are right-handed; relabeling lead and trail sides does not establish mirrored anatomy, coordination, or sensor equivalence.
transportability.data_gate: Retain biological side, playing handedness, grip style, and mirrored frame transforms; qualify sensor calibration and predictions separately before pooling or mirroring.

transportability.limitation: The articulated and scapular surrogates are not calibrated to impairment, range restriction, pain, neurological status, or compensatory motion.
transportability.data_gate: Define each target impairment clinically, retain range and functional constraints, validate subject-specific geometry and sensor observability, and use a separately governed held-out analysis.

transportability.limitation: Driver, iron, rigid, modal, and synthetic shaft cases use non-equivalent equipment and objectives; no universal equipment effect or calibrated shaft benefit is established.
transportability.data_gate: Retain club make, head, shaft, length, mass, inertia, stiffness, damping, grip, ball, impact location, calibration, and participant-club assignment; test held-out equipment strata.

transportability.limitation: Maximum speed, carry, accuracy, load, robustness, partial swings, clubs, and impact definitions are distinct tasks; an optimum under one objective cannot be promoted to another.
transportability.data_gate: Preregister shot intent, target, club, outcome vector, constraints, impact definition, acceptable-shot criteria, fatigue state, and multi-objective comparison before estimating a strategy effect.
